cases.goal: Reject missing, misspelled, or unknown record fields instead of accepting a false no-change checkpoint.
Preserve every distinct prompt, reopen an earlier checkpoint, and accept an incremental correction after a same-id steer.
Detect the long post-checkpoint window seen in the audited premature-checkpoint failures and require reconciliation.
Detect tool work immediately after a checkpoint without relying on a sixty-second delay.
Allow a causal map to grow beyond 24 meaningful concepts while retaining per-turn, root, depth, and chronology guards.
Preserve a justified settled-to-open transition when later evidence reopens the work.
Keep a settled causal parent independent from an unresolved child instead of applying task-style roll-up.
Reject a different payload when no new prompt has legitimately reopened the interaction.
Continue accepting a deliberate checkpoint with a valid empty operations array.
Surface high-confidence stale or contradictory frontier text without automatically changing causal state.
Make an unattended Claude record denial visible and actionable on the next prompt.
